Observed behavior: Recomputes coverage and references. Recognized archive content labels can override stale database pointers. Refuses selected files outside the scanned media set and checks retained provable coverage before removal and repointing.
Limit / proposed control: Chapter coverage and surviving path existence leave byte identity, link counts and crash recovery unproven. The function accumulates the removed file's size without measuring reclaimed storage.

Observed behavior: Attempts exclusive rename on Linux or Darwin, with hardlink fallback when the primitive is unavailable or unsupported.
Limit / proposed control: The fallback needs same-filesystem support. Require actual NTFS, SMB and Unraid results for no-overwrite and recovery claims.

Observed behavior: One-time repair groups by series and relative path comparison key, folds case on Windows, repoints chapter and health rows, invalidates archive cache and deletes extra database rows in a transaction.
Limit / proposed control: Path comparison and host OS rules alone leave underlying file identity and case-sensitive directories unproven. The completion flag is written after the merge transaction.

Observed behavior: Runs page count and hash rounds before folding each settled batch. A deadline triggers a final bounded fold attempt and leaves remaining work to the page hash job.
Limit / proposed control: The worker and its intermediate results provide no authority for physical deletion. Fold and filesystem operations require separate coverage and ownership checks.

Observed behavior: Skips unavailable root groups, calculates page hashes, leaves manual overrides in place and records a page-zero visit marker even when no page is readable.
Limit / proposed control: A visit marker establishes attempted processing. Preserve separate records for successful content verification and retry eligibility.

Observed behavior: Per-directory writability preflight. Lexical path resolution and realpath-checking helper validate a resolved existing parent against the root.
Limit / proposed control: Point-in-time path validation and write preflight do not fence a remounted or replaced root. Verify all mutation callers and target filesystems.

Observed behavior: Branch-only blocked-group purge previews single-chapter download-root rows, skips unsettled numbering, and rechecks the selected IDs under the series writer claim and DB locks before invoking purgeBooks.
Limit / proposed control: A blocked group is a content policy decision. It supplies neither duplicate proof nor a reason to remove progress automatically. The file is absent at v0.109.0.

Observed behavior: Shared purge checks download-root containment and reachability, removes backup and media, then deletes matching progress, bookmarks, offline state and selected catalog records.
Limit / proposed control: Filesystem operations precede SQL removal. A transaction rollback alone cannot restore the removed files. Keep audit approval and recoverable quarantine separate from a source blocklist.

Observed behavior: Foreign-UID fixture locates its actor image by requiring exactly one literal digest-pinned Python FROM instruction.
Limit / proposed control: The pinned multi-stage Dockerfile has two FROM instructions, so actor setup stops before the cross-UID assertion. Keep the upstream test setup error distinct from the storage fixture result.

Observed behavior: Uses the shared foreign-UID actor fixture. Other tests independently inspect ownership through a live guard and account for committed SQLite WAL contents.
Limit / proposed control: The cross-UID assertion did not run in the attempted suite. Other passing observations are specific to their own fixtures.

Observed behavior: Reads enqueued, scheduled and processing jobs. Tracks IDs in process to cover the transition after a worker takes a job and before monitoring marks it Processing.
Limit / proposed control: Queue visibility is scoped to that storage and tracked IDs. This does not establish storage generation identity or persistent mutation leases.

Observed behavior: Pinned start mutation checks DOWNLOAD_CHAPTERS and returns current status immediately for an empty queue. It waits for Started only for a nonempty queue.
Limit / proposed control: Published v2.4.2373 uses a different implementation, and the empty-queue runtime timed out. Gate the adapter by verified engine behavior.

Observed behavior: Duplicate library SQL finds other favorites by normalized title substring or matching nonzero remote ID in the same tracker, and counts chapters excluding scanlators the user excluded.
Limit / proposed control: These are catalog review candidates. Physical duplicate proof needs edition, file identity and content evidence.

Observed behavior: Decoder reads metadata without decoding all entries, streams entries separately, selects gzip by magic and rejects recognized JSON signatures.
Limit / proposed control: Matching gzip magic alone gives no assurance of cross-engine field, legacy format or restore semantics.
